decisions.reason: The legacy formatting-removal and style-application workflow does not change the independent requirement that manual line breaks work after pasted content.
The workflow does not necessarily resolve or change the required containment and stability of pasted tables and columns.
Applying styles from the new template does not establish whether those styles must use the PBU prefix or resolve the existing naming ambiguity.
The legacy transfer workflow does not change the supported environment or the requirement for stable behavior across multiple users.
The post-paste instruction to apply styles already provided by the new template does not alter the requirement to deploy the prescribed style system consistently across templates.
The source workflow does not change any bullet size, balance, alignment, reference, or color requirement.
Removing legacy formatting and applying template styles does not change or resolve the independently required Tab-based list interaction.
The legacy-content transfer workflow does not change the Title field's requirement to preserve formatting during entry or replacement.
The source decision contains no change to the document's default language configuration.
The legacy transfer workflow does not change the required double-digit numbered-list alignment, and the same-message runtime observation is already represented without implying a value change.
The page-two numbering requirement from the same source message is already fully represented by its existing INTRODUCE Event; no additional propagated MODIFY is needed.
The legacy transfer workflow does not change the required language of template style names.
